name: Aravali Ranges
biomes_note: Recorded from the species canon already places here -- hills and plains carry seven each, forest and mountains four. It was the last region with an `extent` drawn on the atlas and no biomes at all, which meant nothing could be laid out in it: `region_gedrosian_desert` had the same gap and was closed the same way. Advisory, as the schema says -- a field map's `seed_biomes` is still what the generator draws from, and a map here would want a cheap biome in the palette because hills, forest and mountains are all travel cost 2 or worse.
notes: Stony ranges. Site of Mask Family schism, Jharwa massacre, and hidden sanctuary of Vara-Ma/Orek/Thren.
